description: This file defines the implementation of the MediaKeySessionTestBase class, which provides mock-based setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing MediaKeySession behavior in a media key session context. It includes mock object creation, session management, and expectations for interactions with external components such as the main thread, Ocdm system, and session objects.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing setup, expectations, and utility functions for testing MediaKeySession objects, including mock object management and session lifecycle control.

methods.name: MediaKeySessionTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects for testing.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Sets up expectations and creates a MediaKeySession instance with the specified key system.

methods.name: destroyKeySession
methods.description: Sets expectation for unregistering the client from the main thread.

methods.name: expectCloseKeySession
methods.description: Sets expectations for closing or cleaning up a session based on the key system.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Sets expectation for constructing a session with specific init data and verifies the generateRequest method's success.

methods.name: mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread and executing it immediately.
